title: Thieyn as cummal
description: Ten short stories about homes and living on the Isle of Man: a student house, a novelist's house on the coast, a pig farm, a housing scheme, an old house remodelled, a guest from a twin town, a chapel turned into a home, a flat above a hairdresser's, a glasshouse of tropical plants and a house on the race course.

lessons.title: Thie ny studeyryn
lessons.summary: Amber, a physics student, moves into a narrow room in a student house in Douglas; her parents want her to have a bigger table, and her two housemates, who study chemistry and evolution, help her carry an old one in from the garden.
lessons.text:
Ta Amber Comish nuy bleeaney jeig d'eash. T'ee ny studeyr ec y cholleish ayns Doolish, as t'ee lhaih fishig. 'Sy tourey, hie ee dy chummal ayns thie studeyryn er straid keyl faggys da'n phurt.

Haink e daa phaarant dys Doolish neesht. Ren ny paarantyn e lioaryn as e reddyn y ymmyrkey seose dys y shamyr eck. Va'n shamyr keyl as beg, as cha row agh taabyl beg ayn.

“Cha nel y taabyl shoh cooie son studeyr,” dooyrt e moir. “T'ou laccal taabyl mooar son yn obbyr ayd.”

“Ta mee laccal taabyl mooar,” dooyrt Amber, “agh cha nel argid aym son taabyl noa.”

Ta daa studeyr elley cummal 'sy thie. Ta Gary lhaih kemmig. Ta Sasha lhaih bea-oaylleeaght, as t'ee ynsaghey mychione aafilley: cre'n aght ta cretooryn caghlaa rish ymmodee thousaneyn dy vleeantyn.

Yn oie shen, ren ny tree studeyryn bee y yannoo ry-cheilley. Dooyrt Amber dy row ee laccal taabyl mooar.

“Ta taabyl mooar shenn ayns y garey cooyl y thie,” dooyrt Gary. “V'eh ec studeyryn roin, agh cha nel eh ec peiagh erbee nish.”

Lurg y bee, hie ny tree studeyryn magh dys y garey. Va'n taabyl trome, as va duillagyn as ushtey er.

“Shoh fishig,” dooyrt Amber. “Ta feme ain er forsey mooar dy hroggal eh. My nee shin troggal eh ry-cheilley, bee forsey dy liooar ain.”

Ren ad y taabyl y hroggal, as ren ad eh y ymmyrkey stiagh 'sy thie.

“As nish, kemmig,” dooyrt Gary. Hug eh ushtey çheh er y taabyl, as ren eh y taabyl y ghlenney.

“As shoh aafilley,” dooyrt Sasha, as ren ee gearey. “Va'n taabyl shenn as doo. Nish t'eh glen as bane. T'eh er chaghlaa!”

Va'n taabyl ro vooar son y shamyr keyl. Hug ad eh 'sy shamyr vooar 'sy thie. Nish ta ny tree studeyryn gobbraghey ec y taabyl dagh oie. Ta Amber lhaih fishig, ta Gary lhaih kemmig, as ta Sasha lhaih mychione aafilley. Ta'n taabyl cooie son tree studeyryn.

Haink paarantyn Amber dy akin ee mee ny lurg shen. “Vel taabyl mooar ayd nish?” dooyrt e ayr.

“Ta,” dooyrt Amber. “As ta daa charrey aym ec y taabyl neesht.”

Feyshtyn:
Cre ta Amber lhaih ec y cholleish?
T'ee lhaih fishig ec y cholleish ayns Doolish.
Row'n shamyr eck keyl?
Va. Va'n shamyr keyl as beg.
Quoi ta lhaih kemmig?
Ta Gary lhaih kemmig.
Cre ta Sasha ynsaghey mychione?
T'ee ynsaghey mychione aafilley.
Row'n taabyl mooar cooie son y shamyr keyl?
Cha row. Va'n taabyl ro vooar son y shamyr keyl.

lessons.title: Yn noaskeealagh as y shilley
lessons.summary: Alison, a novelist who writes romance, leaves a noisy street in Douglas for a small house on the south coast; the wide view of the sea and the clouds and two swans on a lake go into her new novel.
lessons.text:
Ta Alison Taggart ny noaskeealagh. T'ee screeu lioaryn romanseeaght: skeealyn mychione graih. She romanseeaght yn genre eck, as ta ram sleih lhaih ny lioaryn romansagh eck.

Rish jeih bleeaney, va Alison cummal ayns thie beg er straid vooar ayns Doolish. Va sheean ny gleashtanyn kinjagh, oie as laa. Cha row shilley erbee veih'n thie eck agh boalley thie elley.

'Sy vlein shoh, chionnee Alison thie slystagh er slyst jiass yn ellan. Ta'n thie beg as shenn, agh ta shilley lheeadagh echey. Veih'n shamyr eck, t'ee fakin y keayn, ny creggyn as yn aer. Ta'n shilley caghlaa dagh oor. Tra ta'n ghrian soilshaghey, cha nel bodjal erbee 'syn aer. Er laa elley, ta bodjallyn mooarey doo çheet veih'n sheear, as ta'n fliaghey tuittym er y cheayn.

Ta'n gheay kinjagh ec y thie slystagh, as ta'n thie feayr 'sy gheurey. Agh s'mie lesh Alison eh. “Ta gheay kinjagh ny share na sheean kinjagh ny gleashtanyn,” t'ee gra.

Faggys da'n thie, ta logh beg. Ta daa ollay cummal er y logh. Ta ny ollee bane as mooar. Dagh laa, ta Alison goll dys y logh, as t'ee cur bee da ny ollee.

Ec y thie noa, ren Alison toshiaght er noaskeeal noa. She skeeal romansagh eh mychione daa pheiagh ta çheet ry-cheilley ec logh slystagh. Ta daa ollay 'sy skeeal neesht, as ta'n daa pheiagh fakin ny ollee dagh laa.

Haink carrey dy akin Alison. “Vel oo caghlaa yn genre ayd?” dooyrt eh.

“Cha nel,” dooyrt Alison. “She romanseeaght ee foast. Agh nish ta bodjallyn, gheay as ollee 'sy lioar.”

Hie e charrey dys y shamyr eck, as v'eh jeeaghyn er y shilley lheeadagh. “Ta'n shilley shoh feer romansagh,” dooyrt eh.

Ec jerrey y vlein, va'n noaskeeal noa jeant. Ta sleih gra dy nee yn lioar share eh ta'n noaskeealagh er screeu rieau.

Feyshtyn:
Cre'n genre ta Alison screeu?
She romanseeaght yn genre eck.
Row shilley ec y thie ayns Doolish?
Cha row. Cha row shilley erbee veih'n thie agh boalley thie elley.
Vel shilley lheeadagh ec y thie slystagh?
Ta. Ta shilley lheeadagh echey er y keayn, ny creggyn as yn aer.
Cre ta cummal er y logh?
Ta daa ollay cummal er y logh.
Vel ollee 'sy noaskeeal noa?
Ta. Ta daa ollay 'sy skeeal romansagh.

lessons.title: Ny muckyn beggey
lessons.summary: Derek breeds spotted pigs on a small farm in the north; one night his sow gives birth to eight piglets, his daughter Lisa learns that pigs are mammals, and the piglets find their mother's teats by instinct.
lessons.text:
Ta Derek Crookall cummal er thalloo beg ayns twoaie yn ellan. Ta thie shenn cloaie echey, as cooyl y thie ta ooir vie. Ta Derek gaase lossreeyn 'syn ooir, as t'eh sheelraghey muckyn.

Ta muc vooar ec Derek, as she Bessie yn ennym eck. She muc vreck ee: t'ee bane lesh brickyn doo. Ta Derek er ve sheelraghey muckyn breck rish feed blein.

Ta inneen ec Derek, Lisa, as t'ee hoght bleeaney d'eash. Ta Lisa ynsaghey mychione sheeintee ec y scoill. “She sheeintagh y vuc,” t'ee gra rish e ayr. “Ta moir y sheeintagh cur bainney da ny paitçhyn eck veih ny keeaghyn eck.”

“Shen eh,” ta Derek gra. “Ta ram keeaghyn ec muc.”

Ayns Averil, rug Bessie hoght muckyn beggey. Va'n ruegys 'syn oie, ayns thie ny muickey. Va Derek as Lisa marish Bessie. Va'n ruegys tappee: haink y chied vuc veg, as eisht yn nah, as eisht ny muckyn beggey elley.

Va paart jeh ny muckyn beggey breck, myr nyn moir, as va paart jeu bane. Lurg y ruegys, hie ny muckyn beggey dys keeaghyn Bessie. Hooar dagh muc veg keeagh, as v'ad giu bainney.

“Cre'n aght ta fys oc c'raad ta'n bainney?” dooyrt Lisa.

“Shen dooghys,” dooyrt Derek. “Cha nel feme ec ny muckyn beggey er ynsaghey. Ta'n dooghys oc ginsh daue c'raad ta ny keeaghyn.”

Lurg y ruegys, va Lisa skee. Hie ad stiagh 'sy thie, as ren Derek jough çheh y yannoo da Lisa. Hug eh jough da Bessie neesht: ushtey glen. “Ta jough feme ec muc lurg ruegys,” dooyrt eh.

Lurg shiaght laa, va ny muckyn beggey cloie mooie. S'mie lesh muckyn ooir: va ny muckyn beggey cloie 'syn ooir, as v'ad doo lesh ooir. “Ta'n dooghys oc ginsh daue cloie 'syn ooir neesht!” dooyrt Lisa, as ren ee gearey.

Feyshtyn:
Vel Derek sheelraghey muckyn?
Ta. T'eh er ve sheelraghey muckyn breck rish feed blein.
Vel Bessie ny muc vreck?
Ta. T'ee bane lesh brickyn doo.
Cre rug Bessie ayns Averil?
Rug Bessie hoght muckyn beggey.
C'raad hie ny muckyn beggey lurg y ruegys?
Hie ad dys keeaghyn Bessie dy gheddyn bainney.
Cre ren Derek da Lisa?
Ren eh jough çheh y yannoo da Lisa.

lessons.title: Yn scheim thieyn
lessons.summary: Brenda chairs the housing committee in Ramsey; a competition picks the plans for forty new homes for young families, a judge hears the neighbours who object, and the homes are built.
lessons.text:
Ta Brenda Mylecharane ny caairliagh er bing thieyn ayns Rhumsaa. Fo kioneys Brenda, ta'n bing gobbraghey er scheim noa: daeed thie noa son lught-thie aegey.

Rish ymmodee bleeantyn, va sleih aegey ayns Rhumsaa gyn thie jeu hene. V'ad cummal marish nyn baarantyn, ny v'ad cur argid mooar son shamyr veg. Cha row shickyrys oc.

Va cohirrey ec y bing son y scheim. Hug kiare possanyn claareyn son ny thieyn noa ayns y cohirrey. Va'n cosneyder ny phossan beg veih Pheeil. Va'n claare oc mie: thieyn beggey lesh garey ec dagh thie.

“S'mie lhiam claare y cosneyder,” dooyrt Brenda. “Ta vondeish mooar ec ny thieyn shoh: t'ad çheh 'sy gheurey, as cha nel ad ro vooar.”

Va pohlldey ec y scheim veih ram sleih 'sy valley. Agh cha row pohlldey ec kuse dy leih va cummal faggys da'n thalloo. “Bee ro ymmodee gleashtanyn er y raad ain,” dooyrt ad. Hug ad y cooish roish briw.

Ren y briw clashtyn rish ny sleih er y daa heu. Dooyrt ny sleih faggys da'n thalloo nagh row ad coardail rish y scheim. Dooyrt Brenda dy row y scheim feer scanshoil son ny lught-thie aegey.

Eisht dooyrt y briw dy row eh coardail rish y bing: va'n scheim mie son y valley. Agh dooyrt y briw dy lhisagh y bing raad noa y hroggal son ny gleashtanyn. Va'n bing coardail rish shen.

Lurg daa vlein, va ny thieyn troggit. Haink ny lught-thie aegey dy chummal ayndoo. “Ta shickyrys ain nish,” dooyrt ben aeg lesh mac beg. “She thie ain hene eh.”

Ta sleih 'sy valley gra dy row kioneys Brenda feer vie. “Va pohlldey yn valley feer scanshoil dooin,” dooyrt Brenda. “As ta'n vondeish shoh ny smoo na argid. She shickyrys eh.”

Feyshtyn:
Quoi yn caairliagh er y bing thieyn?
She Brenda Mylecharane yn caairliagh.
Row cohirrey ec y bing son y scheim?
Va. Hug kiare possanyn claareyn ayns y cohirrey.
Quoi va'n cosneyder?
Va'n cosneyder ny phossan beg veih Pheeil.
Row pohlldey ec y scheim veih ooilley ny sleih?
Cha row. Cha row pohlldey ec kuse dy leih va cummal faggys da'n thalloo.
Row'n briw coardail rish y bing?
Va. Dooyrt y briw dy row eh coardail rish y bing.

lessons.title: Yn thie shenn ayns Pheeil
lessons.summary: Duncan and Pauline remodel a hundred-year-old house in Peel: the walls are rough, the panes are in pieces, a tin of paint will not open, and Duncan hurts his elbow and a vertebra in his back.
lessons.text:
Ta Duncan as Pauline Knickell er chionnaghey thie shenn ayns Pheeil. Va'n thie troggit roish keead blein, as cha row peiagh erbee er ve cummal ayn rish tammylt mooar. Nish t'ad aachummey yn thie.

Ta aachummey thie shenn doillee. Ta ny boallaghyn garroo, as ta ny kerrinyn ayns peeshyn ayns ram jeh ny shamyryn. Ta'n mullagh shenn neesht.

“Cre'n mooadys t'ec y shamyr vooar?” dooyrt Pauline. Ren Duncan y shamyr y howse. “Feed trie er lheead,” dooyrt eh. “Ta'n shamyr vooar ain ayns Doolish jeih trie er lheead. Ta'n shamyr shoh daa cheayrt ny smoo.”

Hoshiaght, ren Duncan ny kerrinyn shenn y ghoaill magh, as hug eh kerrinyn noa stiagh. Va'n obbyr shoh doillee. Va ny kerrinyn noa çhionn 'sy voalley, as va feme er tammylt liauyr son dagh kerrin.

Ren Pauline kelloor y reih son dagh shamyr: kelloor buigh son y shamyr vooar as kelloor gorrym son y shamyr lhie. Va'n peint ayns kishtey beg, as va'n mullagh echey çhionn. Ren Pauline streeu dy osley eh, agh cha row eh foshlit. Eisht ren Duncan eh y osley lesh e laueyn lajer.

Va ny boallaghyn garroo, as va'n peint doillee dy chur orroo. Hug Duncan e uillin noi'n voalley garroo, as va'n uillin echey jiarg as ching. “Cha nel y thie shoh laccal mee!” dooyrt eh, as ren eh gearey.

Lurg shen, ren Duncan claghyn trome y ymmyrkey magh ass y garey. Laa ny lurg shen, va e dreeym feer ching. Hie eh dys y fer-lhee. “Ta vertebra 'sy dreeym ayd er ny scughey beggan,” dooyrt y fer-lhee. “Cha nel ny claghyn shen cooie son y dreeym ayd. Lhisagh Pauline ny claghyn y ymmyrkey nish!”

Lurg shey meeaghyn, va'n obbyr aachummey jeant. Va ny boallaghyn rea, va ny kerrinyn noa glen, as va kelloor noa ayns dagh shamyr. Hoie Duncan as Pauline 'sy shamyr vooar. Va uillin Duncan as y vertebra echey mie reesht.

“Va'n obbyr doillee,” dooyrt Pauline, “agh nish ta thie mie ain.”

Feyshtyn:
Row'n obbyr er y thie shenn doillee?
Va. Va ny boallaghyn garroo, as va ny kerrinyn ayns peeshyn.
Cre'n mooadys t'ec y shamyr vooar?
T'ee feed trie er lheead.
Cre'n kelloor ren Pauline reih son y shamyr vooar?
Ren ee kelloor buigh y reih son y shamyr vooar.
Cre'n aght va uillin Duncan jiarg as ching?
Hug eh e uillin noi'n voalley garroo.
Cre dooyrt y fer-lhee mychione y vertebra?
Dooyrt eh dy row vertebra ayns dreeym Duncan er ny scughey beggan.

lessons.title: Yn inneen veih'n Spaainey
lessons.summary: Kathleen, a linguist, hosts Lucia from her village's twin town in Spain; after a long journey their Spanish, English and Manx talk is hard at first, so Kathleen teaches Manx syllable by syllable and explains a passive sentence.
lessons.text:
Ta Kathleen Kaye ny çhengoayllee. T'ee cummal ayns thie er y chronk, meeiley veih'n balley. Dagh laa, t'ee shooyl y meeiley dys y balley as er ash. Ta'n balley eck lannoonit rish balley beg 'sy Spaainey. Dagh tourey, ta sleih aegey veih'n Spaainey çheet dy chummal marish lught-thie 'sy valley rish mee. She lannoonys mie eh: ta ny sleih aegey ynsaghey mychione y cheilley.

'Sy vlein shoh, haink Lucia, inneen shey bleeaney jeig d'eash, dy chummal marish Kathleen. Va'n turrys eck liauyr: hie ee er etlan dys Sostyn, as eisht er y lhong dys Doolish, as eisht ayns carr Kathleen dys y balley. Lurg y turrys, va Lucia skee.

Ta Spaainish ec Lucia, as Baarle neesht. Ta Kathleen abyl Spaainish y loayrt, agh cha nel ee abyl eh y loayrt dy mie. Ec y toshiaght, va'n çhaghteraght doillee eddyr ny daa ven. V'ad loayrt Spaainish, Baarle as kuse dy Ghaelg, as v'ad gearey dy mennick.

Ta obbyr çhengoaylleeagh ec Kathleen: t'ee screeu mychione sheeanyn 'sy Ghaelg. Ren ee kuse dy Ghaelg y ynsaghey da Lucia, shillab as shillab. “Moghrey mie,” dooyrt Kathleen. “Ta daa hillab ayns ‘moghrey’, as un shillab ayns ‘mie’.” Lurg tammylt, va Lucia abyl y raa y ghra dy mie.

Hug Kathleen lioar veg oayllys da Lucia mychione y balley. Va oayllys ayn mychione y traie, y cheeill as y phurt. Va Lucia lhaih yn lioar oayllys. “Va'n cheeill troggit 'sy vlein 1850,” dooyrt ee. “Cre ta troggit?”

“She raa surransagh eh,” dooyrt Kathleen. “Ayns raa surransagh, cha nel shin gra quoi ren y cheeill y hroggal. Ta raaghyn surransagh ayns Spaainish neesht.” Ren Lucia gearey. “Ta fys aym nish cre'n fa ta obbyr çhengoaylleeagh ayd!” dooyrt ee.

Ec jerrey yn vee, va Lucia abyl kuse dy Ghaelg y loayrt. Va'n çhaghteraght aashagh nish. Roish my hie ee thie, dooyrt Lucia dy jinnagh ee çheet reesht dys y balley lannoonit.

Feyshtyn:
Vel balley Kathleen lannoonit rish balley 'sy Spaainey?
Ta. Ta'n balley eck lannoonit rish balley beg 'sy Spaainey.
Row'n turrys ec Lucia liauyr?
Va. Hie ee er etlan as er lhong.
Row'n çhaghteraght doillee ec y toshiaght?
Va. V'ad loayrt Spaainish, Baarle as kuse dy Ghaelg.
Vel daa hillab ayns ‘moghrey’?
Ta. Ta daa hillab ayns ‘moghrey’.
Vel “va'n cheeill troggit” ny raa surransagh?
Ta. She raa surransagh eh.

lessons.title: Y thie va ny cheeill
lessons.summary: Gordon lives in a former chapel in Douglas with a small tower; when Douglas becomes a city he lends old photographs and the story of the chapel's founder, named on a bronze plaque, to an exhibition.
lessons.text:
Ta Gordon Hampton cummal ayns thie neuchadjin ayns Doolish: v'eh ny cheeill veg. Va'n cheeill troggit 'sy vlein 1882, as va toor beg urree. Ta'n toor foast ayn, as nish she shamyr Gordon eh. Veih'n toor, t'eh fakin y valley ooilley.

Rish shey jeihaghtyn, va sleih çheet dys y cheeill dagh Jedoonee. Va craueeaght feer scanshoil da ny sleih 'sy traa shen. Agh lurg y chaggey, va craueeaght ny sloo scanshoil da paart jeh ny sleih, as haink ny sloo dy leih dys y cheeill. 'Sy vlein 1970, va'n cheeill dooint. Va'n thie creckit, as rish jeihaght ny ghaa cha row peiagh erbee cummal ayn. Nish ta Gordon cummal ayn.

Er boalley y thie, ta lhiaght beg ooha. Ta ennym bunneyder y cheeill er y lhiaght: Josiah Kinread. V'eh ny phersoonid ennoil ayns Doolish 'sy traa shen. V'eh loayrt ec ard-chruinnaghtyn sleih. Ta'n lhiaght ooha shenn, agh t'eh soilshaghey foast 'sy ghrian.

'Sy vlein 2022, hooar Doolish staydys caayragh. Son y feaill caayragh, va taishbynys ayns thie mooar y valley mychione shennaghys Doolish. Ren Gordon ny fotografyn shenn echey y chur da'n taishbynys. Va fotograf ayn jeh'n cheeill as y toor 'sy vlein 1900, as fotograf jeh'n bunneyder hene, as eh shenn.

Haink ram sleih dys y taishbynys. Va ben shenn jeeaghyn er fotograf y cheeill. “Ren my ayr as my voir poosey ayns y cheeill shen,” dooyrt ee rish Gordon. “Va'n bunneyder ny phersoonid vooar 'sy lught-thie ain.”

Lurg y taishbynys, hug Gordon ny fotografyn er boalley y thie. Nish, tra ta sleih çheet dy akin eh, t'eh ginsh daue mychione Josiah Kinread, mychione y toor, as mychione y lhiaght ooha.

Feyshtyn:
Va'n thie ec Gordon ny cheeill?
Va. Va'n cheeill troggit 'sy vlein 1882.
Vel toor er y thie?
Ta. Ta toor beg er y thie, as nish she shamyr Gordon eh.
Cre ta er y lhiaght ooha?
Ta ennym bunneyder y cheeill er y lhiaght: Josiah Kinread.
Cre hooar Doolish 'sy vlein 2022?
Hooar Doolish staydys caayragh.
Cre ren Gordon y chur da'n taishbynys?
Ren eh ny fotografyn shenn echey y chur da'n taishbynys.

lessons.title: Yn thie erskyn y shapp
lessons.summary: Sheila, a hairdresser who lives above her shop in Ramsey, does the hair for a play at the theatre; two actresses arrive in identical gowns, so Sheila lends one of them an old outfit and a pair of softer shoes for her sore heels.
lessons.text:
Ta Sheila Morrison ny folteyr. Ta shapp folteyr eck ayns Rhumsaa: she Sheila shellooder y shapp. T'ee cummal 'sy thie erskyn y shapp. She vondeish mooar eh: cha nel turrys erbee eck dys yn obbyr! Dagh laa, t'ee goll sheese dys y shapp, as ec jerrey yn laa, t'ee goll seose dys y thie eck.

'Sy tourey shoh, ta Sheila gobbraghey son y theater 'sy valley neesht. Ta drama noa 'sy theater, as ta'n drama soit 'sy vlein 1900. Dooyrt shellooder y theater rish Sheila dy vel feme ec ny aghteyryn er folt shenn-aghtagh. Ta folt ellynagh ec paart jeu. Ta Sheila cur kiarail da'n folt ellynagh 'sy shapp eck, as eisht t'ee goll dys y theater.

Er laa yn chied oie, haink daa aghteyr, Rita as Barbara, dys y theater. Va gooyn jiarg ec Rita, as va gooyn jiarg ec Barbara. She yn jarroo gooyn v'ayn: yn jarroo kelloor, yn jarroo cummey.

“Cha nod shin goll magh roish ny sleih lesh yn jarroo gooyn!” dooyrt Rita.

Va gooyn shenn ec Sheila 'sy thie eck erskyn y shapp: gooyn gorrym va ec e moir. Hie ee thie, as haink ee er ash lesh y gooyn gorrym. Va'n gooyn gorrym casley rish y gooyn jiarg: va'n cummey casley, agh cha row'n kelloor casley. Ghow Barbara y gooyn gorrym. Va'n cullee noa cooie son Barbara.

Va braagyn noa ec Barbara, as v'ad ro veg. Va'n daa voyn eck jiarg. “Ta my daa voyn feer ching,” dooyrt ee. Va braagyn bog ec Sheila 'sy thie eck neesht. Hug ee ad da Barbara. “Nish ta'n cullee eck slane,” dooyrt Sheila.

Hug Sheila kiarail da folt Rita as folt Barbara 'sy theater. Hug ee folt ellynagh er Rita, folt liauyr doo. Va'n daa aghteyr aalin.

Va'n drama feer vie. Lurg y drama, haink Barbara dys y shapp lesh y gooyn gorrym. “Gura mie ayd,” dooyrt ee. “Va'n cullee ayd feer vie, as ta my daa voyn mie reesht!” Haink shellooder y theater neesht. “Nee oo gobbraghey son y theater reesht y vlein shoh çheet?” dooyrt eh. “Nee,” dooyrt Sheila.

Feyshtyn:
C'raad ta Sheila cummal?
T'ee cummal 'sy thie erskyn y shapp eck ayns Rhumsaa.
Vel folt ellynagh ec paart jeh ny aghteyryn?
Ta. Ta folt ellynagh ec paart jeu.
Row'n jarroo gooyn ec Rita as Barbara?
Va. Va gooyn jiarg ec Rita, as va gooyn jiarg ec Barbara.
Row'n gooyn gorrym casley rish y gooyn jiarg?
Va. Va'n cummey casley, agh cha row'n kelloor casley.
Cre'n fa va boynyn Barbara jiarg?
Va ny braagyn noa eck ro veg.

lessons.title: Ny lossreeyn grianchryssagh
lessons.summary: Eileen keeps many varieties of tropical plants in a plant house beside her home in a glen; her small tropical bird escapes into the trees around the house and comes back when it grows dark.
lessons.text:
Ta Eileen Oates cummal ayns thie beg 'sy twoaie jeh'n ellan. Ta'n thie cruinnit lesh biljyn mooarey. Er çheu jiass y thie, ta thie lossreeyn. Ayns y thie lossreeyn, ta lossreeyn grianchryssagh: lossreeyn veih ny çheeraghyn çheh.

Ta ram arraghyssyn ec Eileen. Ta queig arraghys as feed jeh lossreeyn grianchryssagh ayns y thie lossreeyn, as ta lossreeyn ayn veih'n Affrick, veih'n Injey as veih America Jiass. Ta un arraghys feer vooar: t'eh ny syrjey na Eileen.

Ta çhiassid as soilshey feme ec ny lossreeyn grianchryssagh. Ayns y gheurey, ta Eileen freayll y thie lossreeyn çheh. Ta feme oc er daa-ocseed carboan myrgeddin. Ta lossreeyn goaill daa-ocseed carboan ass yn aer, as t'ad cur magh ocsygien. Ta Eileen gearey: “Ta mee cur daa-ocseed carboan da ny lossreeyn, as t'ad cur ocsygien dou!”

Ta ushag veg ghrianchryssagh ec Eileen neesht. She Kiwi yn ennym eck, as t'ee buigh as glass. T'ee cummal ayns y thie lossreeyn marish ny lossreeyn.

Laa dy row, va Eileen gobbraghey ayns y thie lossreeyn, as va'n thie lossreeyn foshlit. Ren Kiwi scapail! Hie ee magh, as hie ee seose ayns ny biljyn va cruinnit mygeayrt y thie.

Va Eileen trimshagh. “Ta'n emshir feayr,” dooyrt ee. “She ushag ghrianchryssagh ee, as t'ee laccal çhiassid.” Hie ee mygeayrt y thie, as v'ee shirrey Kiwi ayns ny biljyn. Va Kiwi ayns billey ard, agh cha daink ee sheese.

Ec jerrey yn laa, va'n aer feayr as dorraghey. Hug Eileen soilshey 'sy thie lossreeyn, as daag ee eh foshlit. Lurg tammylt, haink Kiwi stiagh reesht. Va'n scape ec jerrey.

“Va scape mooar ayd jiu,” dooyrt Eileen rish Kiwi. “Agh ta fys ayd foast cre'n boayl ta'n thie ayd.”

Feyshtyn:
Vel thie Eileen cruinnit lesh biljyn?
Ta. Ta'n thie cruinnit lesh biljyn mooarey.
Vel ram arraghyssyn ec Eileen?
Ta. Ta queig arraghys as feed jeh lossreeyn grianchryssagh eck.
Cre ta ny lossreeyn goaill ass yn aer?
T'ad goaill daa-ocseed carboan ass yn aer.
Ren Kiwi scapail?
Ren. Hie ee magh, as hie ee seose ayns ny biljyn.
Haink Kiwi stiagh reesht?
Haink. Haink ee stiagh 'sy thie lossreeyn ec jerrey yn laa.

lessons.title: Shiaghtin ny ratçhalyn
lessons.summary: Stephen rents rooms in his house on the race course to visitors; Ingrid from Scotland has come to fulfil an old wish to see the races, a sore tooth with a bare nerve nearly spoils it, and the race week is a success.
lessons.text:
Ta Stephen Duke cummal ayns thie mooar er y raad eddyr Rhumsaa as Doolish. Ta'n raad shoh ny ayrn jeh coorse ny ratçhalyn mooarey. Dagh blein, ayns Mean Souree, ta ratçhal mooar er y raad, as ta ram sleih çheet dys yn ellan.

Ta shey shamyryn ec Stephen, as rish y ratçhal t'eh cur ny shamyryn da sleih veih çheeraghyn elley. 'Sy vlein shoh, ta turryssagh veih Nalbin ayns y chied shamyr: Ingrid, ben veih Glaschu.

“Rish feed blein, va mee laccal fakin y ratçhal shoh,” dooyrt Ingrid rish Stephen. “Nish ta mee cooilleeney y smooinaght shen.”

Agh er y chied laa, va feeackle Ingrid feer ching. Cha row ee abyl gee. “Cha nod mee fakin y ratçhal myr shoh,” dooyrt ee.

Ghow Stephen Ingrid dys fer-lhee feeacklyn ayns Rhumsaa. Ren y fer-lhee jeeaghyn er y feeackle. “Ta'n nearag 'sy feeackle shoh rooisht,” dooyrt eh. “Shen yn oyr ta'n feeackle ching. Bee'n nearag ching derrey nee mee yn feeackle y lhiasaghey.” Ren eh y feeackle y lhiasaghey, as nish cha nel y nearag ching.

Laa ny lurg shen, va Ingrid as Stephen soie ec y raad faggys da'n thie. Haink ny chied fir ratçhal seose y raad, feer tappee. Va Ingrid gearey. “Ta mee cooilleeney y smooinaght aym!” dooyrt ee.

Va shiaghtin ny ratçhalyn rahoil. Cha row drogh emshir erbee, as va ram sleih ec y coorse. Va'n turryssagh ayns y chied shamyr gearey, as va Stephen gearey neesht.

Roish my hie Ingrid thie, dooyrt ee: “Va'n shiaghtin rahoil, as nish cha nel y feeackle aym ching. Bee mee ayns shoh reesht y vlein shoh çheet.”

Feyshtyn:
Vel thie Stephen er coorse ny ratçhalyn?
Ta. Ta'n raad ec y thie ny ayrn jeh coorse ny ratçhalyn.
Quoi ta'n turryssagh ayns y chied shamyr?
She Ingrid, ben veih Nalbin, yn turryssagh ayns y chied shamyr.
Cre'n oyr va feeackle Ingrid ching?
Va'n nearag 'sy feeackle rooisht.
Row shiaghtin ny ratçhalyn rahoil?
Va. Cha row drogh emshir erbee, as va ram sleih ec y coorse.
Vel Ingrid cooilleeney y smooinaght eck?
Ta. T'ee fakin y ratçhal lurg feed blein.
